german: Gott stirbt nicht.
english: God does not die.

german: Der Mensch lebt nicht lange.
english: A human being's life is short.
notes: Zaza phrasing appears literally to use "his life is short."

kurmanji_lerch: Diâ külfetân ž wan haz dikê.
german: Die Mutter liebt ihre Kinder.
english: The mother loves her children.
notes: Russian and German witnesses read `χóe`, not gamma.

kurmanji_lerch: De memkî wêda šîr pur heiye.
german: Sie hat viel Milch in den Brüsten.
english: She has much milk in her breasts.
notes: User review note confirmed `zāf`; `é̱stu` has acute plus line below.

german: Ihr Mann liebt sie.
english: Her husband loves her.

german: Diese Frau war schwanger (in der Uebers.: "ist schw.").
english: This woman is pregnant.
notes: German prompt says "was pregnant," but the Zaza sentence corresponds to "is pregnant"; Russian has a typo fixed in German: Ā́ja -> Ā́ya.

german: Vor sechs Tagen hat sie einen Sohn geboren.
english: Six days ago she gave birth to a son.
turkish: Altı gün önce bir oğul doğurdu.

german: Sie ist noch krank.
english: She is still sick.

german: Ihre Tochter sitzt bei ihr und weint.
english: Her daughter sits beside her and cries.
notes: Marked `h` follows the Lerch `h̔` review-bucket convention rather than `ḫ`.

german: Das Kind will nicht saugen.
english: The child does not want to suckle.

german: Das Mädchen kann noch nicht gehen.
english: The girl cannot yet walk.

german: Sie ist vor einem Jahre und zwei Monaten geboren.
english: She was born one year and two months ago.
turkish: Bir yıl iki ay önce doğdu.

german: Diese vier Knaben sind alle gesund.
english: These four boys are all healthy.

zaza_lerch: Yau ve̱rī́e vāz dāmu, aúe díene perén’u (kai kén’u), aúe h̔irī́ne lauk vā́nu, aúe t̮eherī́ne h̔o̤wén’u.
kurmanji_lerch: Eyêk debêze, edudûân röe xöl dikê, esêsiân dîstere, eṭârân deckên'e.
german: Der erste läuft, der zweite springt, der dritte singt, der vierte lacht.
english: The first runs, the second jumps, the third sings, the fourth laughs.
turkish: Birincisi koşar, ikincisi zıplar, üçüncüsü şarkı söyler, dördüncüsü güler.
notes: Printed line break divides `t̮e-heríne`; joined here as one word.

german: Dieser Mann ist blind.
english: This man is blind.

german: Seine Frau ist taub.
english: His wife is deaf.

zaza_lerch: Vé̱ngi me̱ (Sé̱ki ma vā́d̮i) ńéšna wén’a.
german: Sie hört nicht, dass wir reden.
english: She does not hear that we are speaking.
notes: Likely error in the original transcription: `???na w?n?a` probably represents one word, `???naw?n?a` (?-??naw-?n-a = neg-hear-IPFV-3SG.F).

german: Dein Bruder niest.
english: Your brother sneezes.

german: Deine Schwester schläft (in d. Uebers. "schlief.").
english: Your sister is sleeping (in the translation: "slept").

german: Euer Vater ist wach.
english: Your father is awake.

german: Er isst und trinkt (sehr) wenig.
english: He eats and drinks very little.

german: Die Nase ist in der Mitte des Gesichts.
english: The nose is in the middle of the face.

zaza_lerch: Di̥ língi mā é̱sti, hérgu dé̱sti mā́de pāṅd̮ ingíšti é̱sti.
kurmanji_lerch: Her merüki du lingi (ningî) wi hênin, her destki pend bêṭi wi hênin.
german: Wir haben zwei Füsse und an jeder Hand fünf Finger.
english: We have two feet and five fingers on each hand.
turkish: İki ayağımız ve her elde beş parmağımız vardır.

german: Die Haare wachsen auf dem Kopfe.
english: Hair grows on the head.

german: Die Zunge und die Zähne sind in dem Munde.
english: The tongue and the teeth are in the mouth.

zaza_lerch: Dé̱stu rā́št qóatu sei dé̱sti t̮é̱pi.
kurmanji_lerch: Pie râste ž pie ṭepe xûrtere.
german: Der rechte Arm ist stärker als der linke.
english: The right arm is stronger than the left.
notes: Dest is literally "hand" but it may have also been used for arm, hence the German gloss.

german: Ein Haar ist lang und dünn.
english: A hair is long and thin.

german: Das Blut ist roth.
english: Blood is red.

german: Die Knochen sind hart wie Stein.
english: Bones are hard like stone.

kurmanji_lerch: De mâsida ṭav heiye, gôh tun'e.
german: Der Fisch hat Augen, aber keine Ohren.
english: The fish has eyes, but no ears.
turkish: Balığın gözleri vardır ama kulakları yoktur.

german: Dieser Vogel fliegt langsam.
english: This bird flies slowly.

german: Er lässt sich zur Erde nieder.
english: It comes down to the ground.

german: Er hat schwarze Federn in den Flügeln.
english: It has black feathers in its wings.

zaza_lerch: Dā́rede vé̱lgō té̱ze, gíli hi̥šni é̱sti.
kurmanji_lerch: Dâre pêre hêšin hênin, gilî gir hênin.
german: Der Baum hat grüne Blätter und dicke Aeste.
english: The tree has green leaves and thick branches.
turkish: Ağacın yeşil yaprakları ve kalın dalları vardır.

zaza_lerch: Ē̱no’e teir nā́kure bāryék é̱sta, bṓ’et̮e qí̥lma é̱sta.
kurmanji_lerch: Va teira nekûlki wi derêž heiye, bôṭa wi qîme.
german: Dieser Vogel hat einen spitzen Schnabel und kurzen Schwanz.
english: This bird has a pointed beak and a short tail.
turkish: Bu kuşun sivri gagası ve kısa kuyruğu vardır.
notes: Final review reads `bo???et?e`; earlier crops made this word difficult to confirm.

german: In seinem Neste hat er weisse Eier.
english: In its nest it has white eggs.

zaza_lerch: Adí̥r ve̱šén’u, du, qí̥le, ko̤mṳ́r me̱ vién’i.
kurmanji_lerch: Âr dešâü'te, em tutüne, gôri, rêšu debînin.
german: Das Feuer brennt: wir sehen den Rauch, die Flamme und die Kohlen.
english: The fire burns: we see the smoke, the flame, and the coals.
turkish: Ateş yanar: dumanı, alevi ve kömürleri görürüz.

german: Das Wasser in dem Flusse fliesst geschwinde.
english: The water in the river flows quickly.

kurmanji_lerch: Hîv že istîrkân girtere, ž röe putüktere.
german: Der Mond ist grösser als die Sterne und kleiner als die Sonne.
english: The moon is larger than the stars and smaller than the sun.
turkish: Ay yıldızlardan büyüktür ve güneşten küçüktür.
notes: Russian scan is partly clipped at the bottom; German witness appears to read `q??d?a`, though `q??d?a` may be expected.

german: Gestern Abend fiel Regen.
english: Yesterday evening rain fell.

zaza_lerch: Eíru sebá me múndiai aíšma fátma día.
kurmanji_lerch: Irö sebeda pista fâtinân nêbia me dî.
german: Heute Morgen sah ich den Regenbogen.
english: This morning I saw the rainbow.

kurmanji_lerch: Be şev târîe, be rö roanîke.
german: Des Nachts ist es finster und am Tage hell.
english: At night it is dark and by day bright.

german: Wir reden kurdisch (Kurmändi-Zazä).
english: We speak Zaza.

german: Versteht ihr kurdisch (Kurmändi-Zazä) zu sprechen?
english: Do you know how to speak Zaza?
notes: Zaza line specifically asks about knowing Zaza.
